decisions.decision: Scrapped co-occurrence graph, replaced with bipartite document-entity graph
decisions.rationale: Co-occurrence blob hides documents — the archival descriptions are the point

decisions.decision: Entity detail page is primary home for graph, not explorer
decisions.rationale: Ego-network from one entity is legible; explorer's 20 random entities are not

decisions.decision: Graph builds from entity-link shards on demand, not pre-computed JSON
decisions.rationale: 90K shards already exist, no new pre-compute step needed

decisions.decision: Click-to-expand fetches entity page HTML for name/type instead of Pagefind
decisions.rationale: Pagefind search by entity code returns wrong results — codes too short. Entity code added to Pagefind body in template for future rebuild.

decisions.rationale: Entity explorer deep-link not yet built — next task
